events.title: Mockingbird Wine Tasting Dinner with Rachel Nasatir
events.description: Join us for a special evening at The Mockingbird as we welcome Rachel Nasatir of Cutting Edge Selections for a guided wine tasting dinner. The night features a five-course Greek-inspired menu with wine pairings presented throughout the evening. Menu includes Whipped Feta Mezze, Horiatiki, slow-simmered Mavromatika Soup, Greek Sheet Pan Chicken and Vegetables, and Yiaourtoglyko. Reservations are required and seating is limited.

events.title: Wine & Canvas: Sunset Toast
events.description: 🌅🎨🍷 Paint Sunset Toast on a rustic staggered wood pallet at The Mockingbird on Mill Road. This guided, beginner-friendly experience walks you step by step through a glowing coastal sunset with ocean waves, wine glasses, and tropical flair. No experience needed — just sip, relax, and create. Food, wine, flatbreads, and more available for purchase. $50 per guest.
